_help: Hand-curated events for cities whose calendars block automated access. Each entry was checked on or before 2026-10-21 against the organizer's or venue's own public page, linked in 'url'. scripts/update_events.py merges this file into events.json, drops past events and removes duplicates. Edit freely; keep ISO dates in Pacific time.

events.description: Exhibition centered on a monumental ancient bronze Reclining Vishnu on loan from the National Museum of Cambodia, exploring Hindu cosmic-ocean myths. On view Oct. 23, 2026-Jan. 25, 2027.

events.title: Halloween Hoopla
events.description: Long-running free Halloween party for kids and families in the Children's Garden. RSVP encouraged.

events.title: SACHI Talk: Calm and Chaos of Vishnu's Cosmic Ocean
events.description: Free First Sunday double talk by curators Natasha Reichle and Forrest McGill on the Reclining Vishnu bronze and how ancient Cambodian rulers drew on Hindu cosmic-ocean myths.

events.title: Roopa in Flux
events.description: Bay Area-raised vocalist Roopa Mahadevan and her ensemble mix Carnatic classical music with jazz, soul and improvisation, with Rohan Krishnamurthy on mridangam and drums. Shows at 6 and 7:30 p.m.; $34.

events.title: NightLife: Pajammy Jam (21+)
events.description: Pajama-party edition of the Academy's Thursday night museum party with music, games and exhibits after hours. 21+ with photo ID; $26.

events.title: NightLife: Naughty or Nice (21+)
events.description: Holiday-themed NightLife, the last of the year, with music and after-hours museum exploring. 21+ with photo ID; $26.

events.title: Katha Munch Social Hour (Diwali Celebration)
events.description: Theatre games and community mixing with the Katha Munch troupe, part of the Lesher Center's two-day Diwali Celebration.

events.title: Veterans Day Ceremony
events.description: Free ceremony from the City of Walnut Creek and the Walnut Creek Concert Band honoring veterans with speakers and music.

events.title: After Dark: Death and Life / La muerte y la vida (18+)
events.description: Thursday-night adults-only edition celebrating Dia de los Muertos and the science and culture around the circle of life. 18+.

events.title: We All Journey: Monarchs & Dia de Muertos
events.description: Learn about monarch butterflies' life cycle and migration to Mexico, which often lines up with Dia de Muertos; paint a butterfly and visit a colorful altar.

events.title: Awesome Orchestra Live Rehearsal & Performance
events.description: Watch Awesome Orchestra assemble, rehearse and perform in real time, with music from KPop Demon Hunters and works by composer Oscar Navarro.

events.title: After Dark: Creepatorium (18+)
events.description: The Exploratorium's annual adults-only Halloween party, with Gothicumbia and a science-themed costume contest. 18+.

events.title: After Dark: Digest This (18+)
events.description: Adults-only night on the history and science of how we eat and digest food, from first bite onward. 18+.

events.title: Tri-Valley Veterans Day Parade and Concert
events.description: The 29th annual Tri-Valley Veterans Day Parade steps off at 1 p.m. on Main Street, followed by a free Pleasanton Community Concert Band concert (about 1:30-3 p.m.) at the Veterans Memorial Building.

events.title: After Dark: Unplug and Play (18+)
events.description: Screen-free adults-only night at the Exploratorium with games, hands-on exhibits and play. 18+.

events.title: Glow (winter exhibition)
events.description: The Exploratorium's winter tradition of luminous artworks, light science and optical illusions, on view Nov. 19-Jan. 24.

events.title: After Dark: Glow Opening (18+)
events.description: Adults-only opening night for Glow, with light-based art, optical illusions and glowing exhibits. 18+.

events.title: After Dark: Rule Breakers (18+)
events.description: Adults-only night about trying new things, with a performance by sound artist Ivana Dama. 18+.

events.title: After Dark: Solstice (18+)
events.description: Adults-only winter-solstice night with light-filled experiences and seasonal traditions. 18+.

events.title: Embarcadero Center 40th Annual Building Lighting & Holiday Market
events.description: Embarcadero Center marks 40 years of its holiday building lighting with a street-level holiday market, seasonal activities and the switch-on of the center's lights. Free; RSVP encouraged.

events.title: Civic Center Plaza Tree Lighting 2026
events.description: Free evening across from City Hall with holiday entertainment, crafts, a toy giveaway and "snow" flurries, capped by the lighting of the plaza's holiday tree.

events.title: Holiday Artisan Market 2026
events.description: More than 30 local makers sell jewelry, fashion, home goods, stationery, snacks and kids' gifts over three days (10 a.m.-5:30 p.m. daily). Market entry is free, no ticket needed.

events.title: Artist Talk: Bamboo Art Prizewinner Ōki Toshie
events.description: Japanese bamboo artist Ōki Toshie, Coffland Grand Prize winner of the 2026 New Generation Bamboo Art Prize, talks about her woven sculptures and installations. Included with museum admission.

events.title: Fort Mason Night Market: November
events.description: Evening market at Fort Mason Center from the West Coast Craft team, with local makers, food and drinks on the waterfront.

events.title: West Coast Craft Winter '26
events.description: Two-day winter edition of the juried craft show, gathering independent designers and makers for holiday shopping at Fort Mason.

events.title: WCC WAVES Vintage Market: December
events.description: West Coast Craft's vintage market returns to Fort Mason with curated vintage clothing, accessories and home goods.

events.title: Fort Mason Night Market: December
events.description: December edition of the Fort Mason evening market, with local makers, food and drinks just before the holidays.

events.title: Howl-ooo-ween 2026
events.description: Not-so-spooky fall celebration for kids in costume: animal encounters, crafts, games, face painting and a Mad Scientist, plus a food truck and shaved ice. Tickets required for adults and kids; family-pass pricing for 4+.

events.title: Shadelands FallFest
events.description: Free all-community fall festival (formerly "Made in the Shade") with try-it sports activities, local exhibitors, food trucks and music. Free parking; sign the online waiver to join the sports.

events.title: Oakland Gay Men's Chorus: Make the Yuletide Gay!
events.venue: Del Valle Theater, 1963 Tice Valley Blvd.
events.description: The chorus brings its holiday show of seasonal classics and diva anthems to Walnut Creek for a Sunday matinee.

events.title: Makers Market Outdoor Market
events.description: Free open-air Small Business Saturday market with local makers of jewelry, home goods, apparel, candles and more, plus live music.

events.title: Harvest Festival Original Art & Craft Show
events.description: Long-running art and craft show with original artwork, handmade jewelry, ceramics, decor and specialty foods, plus live entertainment and a KidZone. Fri 10-4, Sat 10-5, Sun 10-4; kids 12 and under free, $5 all day Sunday. Enter Gate 8 or 12.

events.title: Trick-or-Treat Haunted Winery Crawl
events.description: Decorate a wine glass and bring it to each participating winery (Charles R, Fenestra, JMC Cellars, McGrail, Omega Road, Sakura) for a complimentary Halloween splash, no tasting purchase required. 21+.

events.title: Moonlit Masquerade at McGrail
events.description: Masked Halloween evening overlooking the valley: welcome glass of wine and live strings, then a DJ dance party after dark.

events.title: Día de los Muertos Fiesta! with Patrón Latin Rhythms
events.description: Live-band dance party of Latin rock, salsa and R&B with a costume contest at intermission.

events.title: Halloween Bash at Concannon
events.description: Costume party in a fully haunted barrel room with DJ sets, "Scaryoke," dancing and food trucks; first drink included.

events.title: The Killer Dueling Pianos at Concannon
events.description: Request-driven dueling-piano show covering everything from Sinatra and Elvis to Bruno Mars. Doors 6 p.m. with a welcome sparkling pour.

events.title: Gather, Gobble, Cheers with McGrail
events.description: Fifth annual guided tasting of five wine-and-cheese pairings led by a cheesemonger and McGrail's winemaker, featuring the November releases.

events.title: Peter Michael Escovedo and the Allstars
events.description: Emmy-winning percussionist Peter Michael Escovedo leads an all-star ensemble with vocalist Tony Lindsay.

events.title: Josh Rouse
events.description: Singer-songwriter Josh Rouse plays an intimate show ahead of his 15th album, Museums and Women.

events.title: Illeagles: Tribute to the Music of the Eagles
events.description: California Eagles tribute band known for big sing-along shows.

events.title: Holidays in the Vineyards
events.description: Wineries deck out their tasting rooms with holiday wines, local artisan crafts, music and activities (noon-4:30 p.m. both days). Free admission; tasting fees vary. Bring an unwrapped toy for the Toys for Tots drive.

events.title: Jeff Ryan's Cheery Christmas Party
events.description: Contemporary jazz saxophonist Jeff Ryan's holiday show with originals, a few Christmas sing-alongs and a sweater contest.

events.title: Pete Floyd: Pink Floyd Tribute
events.description: Eight-piece Pink Floyd tribute band in Almost Famous's stage room.

events.title: Bay Area Prabasi Diwali Mela & Kali Puja 2026
events.description: Bengali community Diwali mela with festive shopping, food stalls, mehendi, rangoli, diya painting and kids' activities, an evening light show, 108-diya lighting, cultural performances and traditional Kali (Shyama) Puja.

events.title: Opening Celebration for Vishnu's Cosmic Ocean
events.description: Opening day for the monumental Reclining Vishnu bronze from Cambodia: a Cambodian Buddhist temple water blessing at 11:30 a.m., Khmer dance at noon, plus tours, family storytelling and drop-in art activities. Free with museum admission.

events.title: ZooLights at the San Francisco Zoo
events.description: The Zoo's first ZooLights since 2018: over a million lights across 14 zones, glowing 3D animals, light-up playgrounds and an after-dark look at Dinos Rule! Wed-Sun, 5:30-9 p.m. Separate evening ticket ($30 adults, $21 children); themed nights and Santa visits in December.

events.title: Smuin's The Christmas Ballet
events.description: Smuin's holiday tradition of classical and contemporary dances to seasonal music, with a new piece by company artist Maggie Carey. Walnut Creek performances Nov 21 (2 & 7:30 p.m.) and Nov 22 (2 p.m.).

events.title: Fleetwood Macramé - A Tribute to Fleetwood Mac
events.description: Fleetwood Mac tribute playing the band's greatest hits live at Almost Famous.

events.title: Laughs in a Glass Comedy Night
events.description: Winery comedy night benefiting Culinary Angels, with 3 Steves wines, Altamont Beer Works beer and a food truck. Doors 5:30 p.m., show 7:30 p.m.

events.title: Breakfast with Santa
events.description: Pancake breakfast with sausage, fruit, coffee and juice at Shannon Community Center, followed by Santa's arrival and holiday photos. Benefits the Dublin High music program, which plays live. $15 residents, $18 non-residents, all ages.

events.title: Bah Humbug! 5K Fun Run/Walk
events.description: Chip-timed holiday 5K run/walk with costume awards (Most Grinch-Like, Best Holiday Spirit). Entrants get a long-sleeved holiday shirt and the Bah Humbug! ornament. $35 through Oct 31, $40 Nov 1-Dec 4, $55 race day.

events.title: Smuin's The Christmas Ballet
events.venue: Blue Shield of California Theater, Yerba Buena Center for the Arts
events.description: Smuin's holiday ballet revue returns to San Francisco Dec 10-24, with 2 p.m. matinees and 7:30 p.m. evening shows on select dates, an ASL-interpreted performance and LGBTQ+ Night on Dec 22.

events.title: Burning Down the House: The Bay Area's Talking Heads Tribute
events.description: Six-piece Talking Heads tribute band and dance party.

events.title: Forejour - Tribute to Foreigner and Journey
events.description: Tribute to '80s rock bands Foreigner and Journey.

events.title: Summer Night City - The ABBA Tribute
events.description: ABBA tribute band with authentic costumes and harmonies, playing hits like "Dancing Queen" and "Mamma Mia."

events.title: The Best Intentions: Motown Christmas (Fri)
events.description: Holiday Motown and old-school R&B show by the vocal group The Best Intentions; first night of a two-night run that usually sells out.

events.title: Victorian Christmas Tours
events.description: Glass House specialty tour on Victorian holiday traditions, then carols on the way to the Boone House with nutcracker nibbles and mulled apple cider. Tours start every 30 minutes from 10 a.m. to noon; registration required. $12 residents, $15 non-residents.

events.title: Golden Follies Holiday Performance at the Dublin Senior Center
events.description: Las Vegas-style holiday revue by the Golden Follies senior performers, with high-energy dance routines and costumes. Tickets online or at the Senior Center front desk.

events.title: Phil of Genesis - A Musical Tribute to Phil Collins & Genesis
events.description: Tribute show recreating the songs of Phil Collins and Genesis, from ballads to chart-topping anthems.

events.title: The Best Intentions: Motown Christmas (Sat)
events.description: Holiday Motown and old-school R&B show by the vocal group The Best Intentions; second night of a two-night run that usually sells out.

events.title: Unity Day
events.description: Wear orange and gather on the Town Green for a community anti-bullying day celebrating kindness, acceptance and inclusion, 2–5 p.m.

events.title: Spooktacular Celebration
events.description: Halloween evening for ages 1–10 with crafts, face painting, games and trick-or-treating. Two sessions (4–5:30 and 6–7:30 p.m.); pre-registration required, no walk-ins.

events.title: Flannel & Foliage: An Autumn Weekend in Danville
events.description: Three-day small-town autumn fan weekend downtown with cast photo ops and panels (Scott Patterson, Kelly Bishop, Sean Gunn and more), live music, trivia, scavenger hunts, screenings and artisan markets. General admission is free; limited All-Access tickets.

events.title: GCA Bay Area Ras Garba (Sat)
events.source: Gujarati Cultural Association of Bay Area
events.description: Second night of the Gujarati Cultural Association's Navratri Raas Garba. Free for active GCA members; others need a ticket.

events.title: Crawl-O-Ween
events.venue: Downtown Danville (check-in at Prospect Park Plaza)
events.description: 21+ Halloween stroll through 20+ downtown businesses with wine, beer and spirits tastings, sweet and savory bites, a commemorative glass and live music. Costumes encouraged.

events.title: Halloween Improv Night at the Village Theatre
events.description: Halloween-themed, fully unscripted scene-based improv games built on audience suggestions, from Spontaneous Mind.

events.title: San Francisco on Ice at Fisherman's Wharf (opens)
events.venue: San Francisco on Ice (2860 Taylor St, next to SkyStar Wheel)
events.description: New outdoor rink with 6,500 sq ft of real ice at Fisherman's Wharf, open daily Nov. 4–Jan. 18 rain or shine. 75-minute sessions; skate rental included; themed nights through the season.

events.title: Día de los Muertos and Diwali Festival
events.description: Free all-ages park festival honoring South Asian and Latinx fall traditions with live performances, cultural dance and song, storytelling, arts and crafts and a fire ceremony. Registration requested.

events.title: SF SPCA Holiday Windows at Macy's Union Square
events.description: 40th year of the holiday windows filled with adoptable puppies and kittens, Wed–Sun noon–5 p.m. Name-your-price adoptions for animals over 5 months. Macy's closed Nov. 26 and Dec. 25.

events.title: Yerba Buena Gardens Holiday Tree Lighting
events.description: The Conservancy's second annual holiday tree lighting in the Gardens, 4–6 p.m. RSVPs appreciated but not required.

events.title: Kristi Yamaguchi Holiday Ice Rink: K-Pop Music Night
events.venue: Kristi Yamaguchi Holiday Ice Rink, City Center Bishop Ranch
events.description: Skate to K-pop favorites during two special evening sessions (5 and 7 p.m.) at the newly canopied City Center rink.

events.title: San Francisco Gay Men's Chorus: Holiday Spectacular
events.description: SFGMC's annual holiday show of seasonal classics and pop holiday hits. Fri Dec. 4 at 7:30 p.m.; Sat Dec. 5 at 2 and 7:30 p.m.

events.title: JCCSF Hanukkah Candle Lighting
events.description: Free community hanukkiyah lighting with sing-along music by Jonathan Bayer and fried treats; crafts from 4 p.m. Repeats every weekday Dec. 7–11.

events.title: Center REP: A Christmas Carol
events.description: Center REP and AXIS Dance Company's digitally immersive adaptation by Harrison David Rivers, directed by Jared Mezzocchi, with young Tim Cratchit at center stage. About 2 hours; ages 6+.

events.title: Kristi Yamaguchi Holiday Ice Rink: Stars & Stripes on Ice
events.venue: Kristi Yamaguchi Holiday Ice Rink, City Center Bishop Ranch
events.description: USA-themed music skate night with patriotic favorites, marking America's 250th anniversary.

events.title: Kristi Yamaguchi Holiday Ice Rink: Olivia Rodrigo Music Night
events.venue: Kristi Yamaguchi Holiday Ice Rink, City Center Bishop Ranch
events.description: Themed evening skating session set to music by Olivia Rodrigo.
